gen-gf-offside-gf-kiwi-maru: Offside stretches its open-ended curves wide and holds one level beat with no weight accents. And Kiwi Maru, a serif with generous letterspace and terminals that stop far from the stem, feels more traditional and editorial beside it.
gen-gf-offside-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Wide, bold and a bit theatrical: Offside spaces its unclosed curves far apart and keeps a quiet, level beat. And Padyakke Expanded One, a classic serif with pitcher-mouthed c shapes, brings a literary, moderate-height counterweight.
gen-gf-offside-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Loose, wide and confident, Offside leaves its curves open and tracks out far, while Stint Ultra Expanded floats each letter apart. Its text serif form feels traditional.
gen-gf-oldenburg-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: BhuTuka Expanded One reads at a leisurely walk, its curvy letters loose and its thin joins as sturdy as the stems. But Oldenburg, with single-stroke brush lines and very shallow lowercase, is the one built to command attention.
gen-gf-oldenburg-gf-hepta-slab: Oldenburg looks like a sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width, with shallow lowercase and every curve left open. Hepta Slab then stretches out each word with breathing counters and no thick-thin shifts, so extended reading feels dignified and bookish.
gen-gf-oldenburg-gf-kiwi-maru: Distinctive from the first line, Oldenburg draws its brush-like strokes at constant width with shallow lowercase. Kiwi Maru takes over below with a moderate lowercase height, generous letterspace and a ring-shaped o, giving the page an editorial, traditional footing.
gen-gf-oldenburg-gf-padyakke-expanded-on: Oldenburg brings a sign-painter's single-stroke brush look and lowercase as shallow as a scratch in glass. And Padyakke Expanded One, a text serif with spread-out glyphs and round bowls of uniform walls, gives that commanding heading a literary, authoritative partner.
gen-gf-oldenburg-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Shallow lowercase and open-ended curves drawn at constant width make Oldenburg instantly recognizable. Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif whose characters float apart with a pipe-cleaner feel, adds traditional authority at a taller moderate height beneath it.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-familjen-grot: Casual and personal, Over the Rainbow looks like a thin steel rod bent into letters. Familjen Grotesk is the lively counterpoint, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and bowls left open on one side.
gen-gf-over-the-rainbow-fs-hind: Hind reads with the steadiness of a drawn string, its lowercase nearly matching its capitals. And Over the Rainbow brings a casual, pen-and-paper handwriting that gives the sans-serif its personality.
